fact: The Presidency says the KOICA-funded, UNDP- and SMEDAN-run US$12m Abuja Centre for Entrepreneurship, with incubation and enterprise support for start-ups, is under construction at the SMEDAN Industrial Development Centre in Idu, Abuja.
SMEDAN, with KOICA funding of $12 million and UNDP, broke ground on the Abuja Centre for Entrepreneurship, to host incubation space and support 500 young entrepreneurs and 400 start-ups.

KOICA and SMEDAN began the ACE Startup Academy 2026 Founder Training in Abuja on 24 August 2026 for about 120 participants in some 50 teams chosen from 3,856 applicants, leading to a roughly six-month business incubation for ten teams.

The NCC signed a 15-year lease of its Digital Industrial Park in Enugu to the state government, which will run it as Enugu Talent City; the NCC says the buildings were completed but are still to be activated.

Voice of Nigeria reports First Lady Oluremi Tinubu laid the foundation stone for the Renewed Hope Startup Hub in Wuye, Abuja, built with a JICA grant of US$10.4 million and run by NITDA once complete.

fact: TechCabal reports that the Nigeria AI Scaling Hub, hosted by Lagos Business School and backed by up to $7.5 million from the Gates Foundation over three years, showcased five ventures at Moonshot 2026; no cohort programme is described.

Korea's CRS record of January 2024 describes a project establishing a Start-up Digital Innovation Academy at the Abuja Enterprise Agency in Abuja, with an academy operating system and a Champion Company fostering programme.

Luminate calls Data Science Nigeria the first dedicated AI start-up incubation hub in Nigeria, spearheading initiatives for entrepreneurship and a platform for start-ups; no programme cohort is described.
Nairametrics reports Ken Saro-Wiwa Innovation Hub in Port Harcourt runs incubation programmes jointly with RIMA and the Chamber of Commerce, and Genesys Tech Hub in Enugu runs a developer fellowship.
Nairametrics ranks Nigerian cities by active tech hubs, with programme-running hubs in Lagos, Abuja, Port Harcourt, Enugu, Kano, Ibadan, Kaduna, Uyo, Akure and Jos.
Nairametrics says Vibranium Valley, a 2,600 square-metre tech campus in Ikeja launched in 2018, houses over 30 technology companies.
Technext24 says the Tertiary Education Trust Fund announced 48 innovation centres, 12 operational, 18 in final procurement and 18 expected by 2025.
NITDA states it has begun an 11.2 million dollar JICA-funded innovation hub in Abuja, with consultants set to start preliminary design.

IHS Nigeria announced on 27 February 2025 the commencement of incubation and acceleration programs at the newly built Ilorin Innovation Hub, a Kwara State Government initiative, with Co-creation Hub and Future Africa as program managers; no startup cohort is stated.
ONDI says it has selected one hub in each of the 36 states and the FCT, 37 in all, for iHatch Cohort 5, to serve as local support partners.
NITDA's ONDI runs the 5-month iHatch incubation programme with JICA, hosted at NCAIR in Abuja, holding the 2nd cohort demo day and opening a 3rd cohort of 8 startups.
